name: pure-insights-command-center
description: Admin command center for the analytics portal: report health, orphaned reports, real-time alerts and cost attribution

scripts.setup: node scripts/check-node.js && npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: node scripts/check-node.js && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev:server: node scripts/check-node.js && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.dev:client: node scripts/check-node.js && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.seed: node scripts/check-node.js && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/check-node.js && npm --prefix server run test:coverage
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
